 Rahul Kumar Giri @ Rahul Giri, S/o Satyendra Giri ... Appellant(s).
 Versus  The State of Jharkhand ... Respondent(s).
 CORAM : SRI ANANDA SEN, J.
SRI GAUTAM KUMAR CHOUDHARY, J.
------
For the Appellant(s) : Mr. Vijay Bahadur Singh, Advocate For the State : Mr. Satish Prasad, A.P.P.
.........
06 /14.08.2024: I.A. No.5454 of 2024 This interlocutory application has been filed by the appellant,
praying therein to suspend the sentence and release him on bail during the pendency of this appeal.
2. The appellant has been convicted for the offence under Sections 366 and 376(2)(n) of IPC and under Section 4 of POCSO Act in connection with Special (POCSO) Case No.49 of 2023.
He has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for ten years with a fine of Rs.10,000/- for the offence under Section 4 of POCSO Act along with other sentences.

3. Heard, learned counsel for the appellant and learned A.P.P. for the State and have gone through the impugned judgment, the evidence and the Trial Court Records.
4.
Opportunity was given to the State to oppose the bail, which the State availed and opposed.
5. On the last date, submission was made that the appellant has already solemnized marriage with the victim.
6. To confirm the aforesaid statement, this Court directed the DLSA, Dhanbad to send a report to this Court.
The DLSA, Dhanbad has sent a report, from which, it is evident that victim has solemnized marriage with Rahul Kumar Giri on 09.12.2021 in Arya Samaj Temple, Delhi.
Now, she is residing in her matrimonial home.

sentences.text: Further, it has been submitted by the learned counsel that the incident cannot be termed is rape rather it is consensual in nature.

8. Considering the aforesaid fact and specially the fact that the appellant has already solemnized marriage with the victim and the victim is residing at her matrimonial home since the date of marriage, we are inclined to allow this Interlocutory application.

Accordingly, upon suspending the sentence, the appellant, namely, Rahul Kumar Giri @ Rahul Giri is directed to be released on bail during the pendency of this appeal, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- (Rs. Ten Thousand)
with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Special Judge POCSO Act,
Dhanbad in connection with Special (POCSO) Case No.49 of 2023 with a condition that this appellant along with victim-girl shall appear and mark his attendance before the DLSA, Dhanbad,
once in every six months till the disposal of this appeal.
9. Accordingly, I.A. No.5454 of 2024 stands allowed.
(ANANDA SEN, J.) (GAUTAM KUMAR CHOUDHARY, J.)

R.S.
